scope: Independent review of GaudiRT design; not a GaudiRT implementation or full-model benchmark
sdk_package_version: 1.24.2-481; exact binary hashes are in environment.txt

timing_method.program: launch_probe.cpp, native C++ Synapse API, fixed input/output addresses
timing_method.graph: FP32 Add followed by ReLU, 4096 elements; compiler fuses the two nodes
timing_method.synchronization: Completion wait after each batch, outside enqueue timer
timing_method.cpu_affinity: CPU 2, NUMA node 0, local to module 0
timing_method.percentile_scope: Percentiles of batch means, not individual launches
timing_method.validation: 4096 FP32 words bit-exact after warmup, after timing, and after input refresh in all arms

sram_to_mme.numerical_check: Two changed-input fixtures, 1024 BF16 outputs each, identity GEMM, bit-exact
sram_to_mme.limits: Proves compiled placement and execution correctness, not SRAM bandwidth or physical transaction counts

limitations: The documented 6401-launch/22.291-us original workload was not reproduced
No independent GaudiRT SCAL replay implementation was built or timed
No new full-model, multi-device, SRAM bandwidth, or EOS-loop performance claim is made
Public and archived protocol headers require version matching to the installed firmware before use
plain-a.log is a failed setup attempt without the required kernel library environment; excluded from measurements
rmw-placement graph fuses away the intermediate; only sram-mme-post.json proves SRAM placement
